title: University Hospital Shuts IT systems down
description: University Hospital in Ohio has taken its IT systems offline after detecting unusual server activity indicative of a potential security breach. The incident was reported on October 23, 2026, and involves the hospital's digital services being shut down as a precautionary measure. No specific technical details or confirmed exploits have been disclosed at this time.
